items.label: Break-even price
items.sentence: Re-routing adds to the contribution only if the price on re-routed gallons is above $1.51 a gallon. Today it is $1.02.
items.solved: Gate $1.35 + transport $0.16 = $1.51 a gallon. At that price a re-routed gallon nets to zero and the contribution stays at the $136,640 of minimums and residual.

items.label: Break-even, transport at the top of its range
items.sentence: With transport at $0.30 a gallon, the top of the range, the price needs to be above $1.65 a gallon.

items.label: Transport, all three at today's price
items.sentence: At today's $1.02, with all three streams at Gulfstar, transport can rise 12% (to $0.179 a gallon) before the net contribution falls below zero. Every re-routed gallon already loses $0.49 at that price; only the minimums and the residual keep the total above zero.

items.label: Bayou Ridge
items.sentence: Bayou Ridge has no headroom: F024 is outside its permit and its well exemption, so that share stays at 0.
items.solved: Permit TWSC-HW-50417 Attachment C and exemption NME-BR-2019-01 list the codes the wells may take; F024 is not one of them.

document.title: What-if: VLS Gulf Coast F024 re-routing
document.heading: What-if
document.subtitle: Stress the decision on the three F024 streams without pretending to predict it. A case moves the share sent to Gulfstar Thermal, the price billed on those gallons and transport, and holds the minimums, the Bayou Ridge share and the residual.

whatif._units: Every *_usd_m field holds USD millions. limit fields hold the same unit as the measure. Gallons are US gallons a year.

_keys.why: The key names are the CAPEX what-if screen's, kept so the screen reads this file unchanged. In this frame they mean:
_keys.watched_measures.forecast: net contribution on the three streams, a year
_keys.watched_measures.committed: third-party cost (Gulfstar gate price and transport)
_keys.program.envelope: today's net contribution with no route: the reference line, not a ceiling
_keys.program.floor: zero: a case below it loses money
_keys.facility.appetite: forecast 0 is the floor; no_route is the reference line
